Fixed generically (internal/live/identity/coalesce.go, new): resolveCoalesceCall decides which argument the language selects using two proofs (provably-null-or-empty to skip, provably-non-null-non-empty to select), declining the whole call on anything undecidable rather than silently falling through - mutation-tested three ways (drop the non-emptiness proof, fall through on undecidable, remove the call entirely), each caught. ## Reproduce it

```
go run ./tools/gauntlet run corpus-lambda-simple
```

Needs Docker (the emulator is pulled at the pinned digest), the AWS CLI, and a
stock `terraform` or `tofu` binary on PATH for the cold deploy. The script is
`live/e2e/corpus-lambda-simple/run.sh`; `BREAK=1` corrupts its assertions to show they are load-bearing.
